tools.title: Tools
tools.description: Utility tools for working with Comarch Optima
tools.xmlFixerDescription: Fix XML files to prepare them for import into Comarch Optima by clearing specific tags
tools.uploadDescription: Upload an XML file or ZIP archive containing a single XML file. The tool will clear BAZA_ZRD_ID and BAZA_DOC_ID tags so the file can be imported in Comarch Optima via Tools → Distributed Work → Import.
tools.dropZone: Drop XML or ZIP file here, or click to browse
tools.successMessage: The XML file has been fixed and is ready for download. BAZA_ZRD_ID and BAZA_DOC_ID tags have been cleared.

documentCompressor.title: PDF Compressor
documentCompressor.description: Reduce file size of PDF or images (PNG, JPEG, BMP) server-side
documentCompressor.pueInfo: ZUS PUE portal requires attached PDF files to be at most 1 MB. Use this tool to compress files that exceed this limit.
documentCompressor.dropZone: Drop a PDF or image file here, or click to browse
